items.q: you lead a small touring band with vocalist (inaudible) Harris and Larry Darnelle

ctx.x: I'll show you that magazine, maybe you can make a copy of it.

Yeah, that would be interesting. I'm going to just -- after the Cavalcade of Jazz, Eddie, is this right, that you lead a small touring band with vocalist (inaudible) Harris and Larry Darnelle. What sort of singer was Larry Darnelle?
He was a blues singer. He could sing (inaudible) Johnny Mathis. (Inaudible.)
